For $n=11$:
$$\binom{5}{2}=10 < 11 \le \binom{6}{2}=15,$$
so the initial degree is $\alpha=4$. Since $11$ is not a complete intersection, $\operatorname{rt}(X)=4$.

\boxed{4}
